book.name: Jeramaiya
book.title: Jeramaiya Jeramaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: King Sedakaiya bin askim Jeramaiya blanga prei
Wal King Nebakanesa brom Bebalon bin meigim Sedakaiya, det san blanga Josaiya jidan nyuwan king langa Juda. Imbin deigim pleis blanga Jehoiyakin det san blanga Jehoiyakim.
Bat nomo Sedakaiya, o im boswan wekinmenmob, o im pipul olabat bin duwit langa det mesij weya YAWEI det trubala God bin gibit langa mi.
Wal King Sedakaiya bin jandim Jehukal, det san blanga Shelemaiya, en det serramonimen neim Sefanaiya, det san blanga Meiseiya blanga askim mi blanga prei langa YAWEI blanga ola pipul.
Wal langa det taim na aibin stil goran ebriweya langa ola pipul dumaji olabat nomo bin pudum mi langa jeil yet.
Det Bebalon ami bin wandim gajim detlot pipul brom Jerusalem, bat wen olabat bin irrim detlot Ijip ami bin krosim det Ijip boda, olabat bin gowei na.
Afta na YAWEI, det trubala God blanga Isreil bin dalim mi
blanga dalim Sedakaiya, “Detlot Ijip ami kaminap na blanga album yu, bat olabat garra gobek langa olabat ronwan kantri.
Bambai detlot Bebalon pipul garra kambek, en olabat garra fait langa dijan taun en gajim ola pipul en dei garra barnimap dijan pleis.
Wal mi na, YAWEI wonim yumob nomo blanga jinggabat detlot Bebalon pipul kaan kambek, dumaji olabat garra kambek.

Nomeda yu gin bidim ol det Bebalon ami, en libum sambala hafded hu leidanbat langa olabat tent, bat stil detlot men garra gidap en barnimap dijan taun, en im garra buldan langa graun.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
Jeramaiya langa jeil
Orait det Bebalon ami bin libum Jerusalem, dumaji det Ijip ami bin kaminap.
Wal aibin stat blanga libum Jerusalem blanga gowei langa det kantri blanga Benjamin blanga gajim main ronwan ebrijing brom main femili.

Bat wen aibin kamap langa det Benjamin Geit, det bos blanga detlot solja hubin wek deya neim Airija, det san blanga Shelemaiya, en det grensan blanga Henanaiya, imbin stapam mi, en imbin tok langa mi, “Wanim yu reken yu dumbat? Ai reken yu libum melabat blanga joinin garram detlot Bebalon pipul.”
Wal aibin ensim im, “Im nomo trubala. Ai kaan go garram detlot Bebalon pipul.” Bat Airija nomo bin irrim wanim aibin tok, en imbin gajim mi, en deigim mi langa detlot boswan wekinmen.
Deibin brabli wail langa mi en deibin beldim mi en lokimap mi langa det haus weya deibin meigim jeil. Det haus bin blanga Jonathan, det men hu oldei raidimdan ebrijing blanga det king.
Deibin pudum mi langa det jeil weya aibin oldei jidan langa rum andanith langa graun en aibin jidan deya longtaim.

Bambai na King Sedakaiya bin jandim im wekinmen blanga gajim mi en deigim mi langa im haus. Imbin askimbat mi kwaitbalawei, “Yubin gedim eni mesij brom YAWEI?” Aibin ensim im, “Yuwai. Dei garra hendimoba yu langa det king brom Bebalon.”
En aibin tok langa im, “Wanim nogudbala ting aibin dum langa yu en yu wekinmen, en langa dislot pipul blanga meigim yu pudum mi langa jeil?
Wanim bin hepin langa detlot speshalwan mesinja hubin dalim yu det king brom Bebalon kaan fait langa yu en yu kantri?

Orait, haibala bos ai wandim yu garra irrim langa mi gudwei, en yu garra dum ebrijing wanim ai garra askim yu. Yu nomo jandimbek mi langa det jeil langa Jonathan haus. If yu garra dum tharran, wal ai garra dai deya.” Lagijat na aibin tok langa det king.

Wal King Sedakaiya bin gibit oda langa im soljamob blanga lokimap mi langa det yad langa im haus. Aibin stap deya na, en ebridei olabat bin oldei gibitbat mi damba brom det pleis weya olabat oldei gugumbat daga raidap ola damba langa det taun bin ol ranat.
